description: 2 tactical challenges for Black in the Rasa-Studier Gambit. Play 3...e4! and develop with 4...Bb4!.

drills.briefExplanation: 3...e4! 4.Ng5 Bb4! 5.e3 d5! — wedge, pin, then the central break.
drills.description: Black to play. White develops 3.Nf3 — strike with 3...e4! and follow with 4...Bb4!.
drills.explanation: The Rasa-Studier Gambit: Black plays 3...e4!, and after 4.Ng5 follows with the sharper 4...Bb4! — pinning the c3 knight. When White tries 5.e3, Black breaks with 5...d5!, opening the center while the pin paralyzes White's queenside. The e4 wedge, the pin, and the break: three ideas in five moves.
drills.name: The Bb4 Pin

drills.briefExplanation: 4...Bb4! 5.e3 Bxc3! 6.bxc3 d5! — pin, remove the defender, break in the center.
drills.description: Black to play. White tries 5.e3 — take the knight at once, then break with 6...d5!.
drills.explanation: Against White's 5.e3 break, Black strikes at once: 5...Bxc3! removes the knight holding White's center together. After 6.bxc3 d5! Black opens the position while White's queenside is shattered — the doubled c-pawns are weak, the bishops will rake the board, and the 'solid' 5.e3 only created targets. The pin punishes every defensive try.
drills.name: Removing the Defender
